title: The Mesnevi (Book 1), with the Acts of the Adepts
edition: James Redhouse's translation of Book 1 of the Mathnawi, preceded by Aflaki's Acts of the Adepts, the early biography of Rumi and his circle, 1881. Project Gutenberg eBook 61724.
summary: The first book of Rumi's great mystical poem in the earliest complete English translation, together with the Acts of the Adepts, a collection of stories about Rumi, his father, his teacher Shams of Tabriz and the first Mevlevi dervishes, written within a lifetime of their deaths. Public domain.
